query: INSERT INTO datatable_migrations (workspace_id, datatable, timestamp, name, code_up, code_down) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, datatable, timestamp) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, code_up = EXCLUDED.code_up, code_down = EXCLUDED.code_down WHERE datatable_migrations.name = $7::text AND datatable_migrations.code_up = $8::text AND datatable_migrations.code_down IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $9::text
